biographies.name: Elena Pekka Marquez
biographies.bio: Renowned conductor and composer.  It's amazing how far a cold-blooded being can get in the music world, but she acknowledges that she has benefited from the mentorship of great musicians before her.

biographies.name: Ada Lin
biographies.bio: Ada played the violin before she could read.  She made her debut at six months old, performing on a custom instrument made just for her paws.  Critics have acclaimed her stylistic integrity and intuitive musicianship, with her trademark warm-and-fuzzy sound.  She can make the instrument truly purr.

items.title: Symphony No. 7 in A major, Op. 92
items.movements:
Poco sostenuto - Vivace
Allegretto
Presto
Allegro con brio
items.programNote: Driven by an unrelenting rhythmic energy, Beethoven called this symphony one of his finest works. Its dance-like momentum carries from the opening movement through the celebrated Allegretto.

items.title: Violin Concerto in E minor, Op. 64
items.movements:
Allegro molto appassionato
Andante
Allegretto non troppo - Allegro molto vivace
items.programNote: Mendelssohn places the solo violin at the heart of the work from its first measure. The concerto is admired for its lyricism, clarity, and seamless dialogue between soloist and orchestra.
